# ARS/Rescue Rooter

> > ARS/Rescue Rooter (American Residential Services) provides HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services across the United States through regional brands including Andy's Statewide, A.J. Perri, and Florida Home.

ARS operates as a national network of home service providers offering heating, cooling, water heater repair, sewer line services, and electrical safety solutions. The company emphasizes community involvement through ARS Cares initiatives, veteran hiring programs, and local partnerships.

## Key Topics
